title: 농촌계획 2024년 제30권 1호
headline: 이번 호의 핵심 흐름은 ‘인구 · 공동 · 마을’(2편)입니다. 가장 많이 등장한 키워드는 ‘rural area · 농촌지역’이며, 서울대학교 연구진이 2편으로 가장 활발했습니다.
bullets: 새로 등장한 키워드: ‘Haengjeong-ri’, ‘Natural population’, ‘Regional extinction index’, ‘social population’, ‘irrigation association’.
주로 쓰인 방법론: 회귀분석, 설문조사, SVM, 드론/UAV.

papers.title: 지방소멸지수와의 비교 연구를 통한 마을소멸지수의 적용 가능성 검토 연구

summary.result: Lastly, the results of the residents' awareness survey also showed that the village extinction index was well reflected in the actual situation of rural villages when applied.
summary.background: The purpose is to propose an index that can better diagnose the extinction of rural villages.
summary.method: As a research method, the regional extinction index and village extinction index are applied to all villages in Haengjeong-ri villages in South Chungcheong Province.

summary.result: As a result, the hierarchical structure was magnified resulting to the exacerbation of community and economic structural imbalances which presents an alternative yet related perspective to the evolution of landscapes during the Japanese colonial period.
summary.background: The study primarily aims to examine the characteristics of the transition from natural landscape to modern agricultural landscape on the Daesan plain in Dong-myeon, Changwon-si, in the lower reaches of the Nakdong River.
summary.method: During the Japanese colonial period, Japanese capitalists initiated the construction of private farms which led to the national land development policy by the Governor-General of Korea.

summary.background: The purpose of this study is to investigate the possible relationship between population migration and population inequality in rural areas.
summary.method: Second, the Theil index was used to quantitatively analyze the level of population inequality between rural areas.

papers.title: 정보화기기 활용이 국내 축산농가 총판매금액에 미치는 영향 분석
papers.title_en: A Study on Effects of Adopting ICT in Livestock Farm Management on Farm Sales Revenue

summary.result: The utilization of ICT in livestock farms leads to a higher increase in sales revenue, particularly for farms with greater sales.
summary.background: Using the 2020 Census of Agriculture, Forestry, and Fisheries, a nationally representative data set constructed by Statistics Korea, this study focuses on a sample of 9,020 livestock farms in South Korea.
summary.method: We employ Propensity Score Matching (PSM) methods to address the potential selection bias between 2,076 farms that used ICT for livestock farm management and 6,944 farms that did not.

papers.title: 과원 규모화 사업이 농가 수익성에 미치는 영향 - 사과를 중심으로 -
papers.title_en: Effect of the Orchard Scale Improvement Project on Farm Profitability - Focusing on Apple -

summary.result: The results of this study can provide useful information to the establishment of government policies and apple farmers who want to participate in the orchard scale improvement project.
summary.background: The purpose of this study is to analyze how the orchard scale improvement project affects the profits of apple farmers.
summary.method: For this purpose, the variable profit function of Apple was estimated using seemingly unrelated regression analysis.
